an5.201:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimilāyaṃ viharati veḷuvane.
an5.201:1.2: athakho āyasmā kimbilo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā kimbilo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.201:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an5.201:1.4: idha kimbila tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā saṃghe agāravā viharanti appatissā sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā aññamaññaṃ agāravā viharanti appatissā
an5.201:1.5: ayaṃ kho kimbila hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo na ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an5.201:2.1: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
an5.201:2.2: idha kimbila tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappatissā dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappatissā saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappatissā sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappatissā aññamaññaṃ sagāravā viharanti sappatissā
an5.201:2.3: ayaṃ kho kimbila hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tathāgate parinibbute saddhammo ciraṭṭhitiko hotīti.
